name: Santos Iron Works LLC - Metal Fabricator
old_description: Providing top-quality welding services in Rockville and the DMV area.
about:
Santos Iron Works LLC operates from Rockville, Maryland, serving the greater DMV area. The company provides welding and metal fabrication services, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The shop specializes in custom steel railings, cable railings, metal staircases, and structural steel fabrication. Its team performs various welding techniques to produce pieces for both safety and architectural appeal. Facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not published.

The company serves residential and commercial construction projects, delivering railings and structural components for homes, offices, and public spaces. Project examples include modern cable railings for unobstructed views and robust steel frameworks for building stability.

Santos Iron Works emphasizes quality workmanship at competitive pricing, highlighting its skilled workforce and attention to design as key differentiators.
